head: ^usage: mhw chrome-debugging --mode=install\|check\|dry-run\|uninstall\|status\n$
why: The usage line names the command as it is now called (mhw chrome-debugging, not the deleted script's file name) and lists the one added mode, status, which global/workstation.py spawns for the mhw status line. The exit code (2) and the stream are still compared, and every argument form that was a usage error is still one.

head: ^chrome-debugging: TypeError: [^\n]*\n$
why: A chrome-devtools entry whose args are a number, a boolean or null made the original raise a TypeError it did not catch, so CPython printed a traceback naming the script's own lines. The Node command prints one line naming the same error class instead. Both exit 1, print nothing on stdout and write nothing; those are still compared.
